title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates for pregnancy
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition plays a crucial role in ensuring the health and well-being of both mother and baby. During pregnancy, the mother's body requires a balanced and diverse diet to support the growth and development of the fetus. A well-planned diet can help meet the nutritional needs of the mother and support a healthy pregnancy.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
There are several international pantry staples that are beneficial for pregnant women, including:
- Oats: rich in fiber, which can help support digestive health and reduce the risk of constipation.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, which can help support the development of the fetus's bones and teeth.
- Lentils: rich in iron, which can help support the production of red blood cells and reduce the risk of anemia.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, which can help support the development of the fetus's brain and eyes.
- Eggs: rich in protein, which can help support the growth and development of the fetus.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, which can help support immune function and reduce the risk of illness.

## Building Balanced Plates for Pregnancy
To create a balanced and diverse diet, pregnant women can combine international pantry staples with traditional Vietnamese foods. For example:
- A bowl of oatmeal with Greek yogurt and fresh fruit.
- A salad of lentils with leafy greens and citrus.
- Grilled low-mercury salmon with roasted vegetables and brown rice.
- Scrambled eggs with leafy greens and whole-grain toast.

## Food Safety Considerations
When preparing and consuming food during pregnancy, it is essential to follow safe food handling practices to reduce the risk of foodborne illness. Some key considerations include:
- Washing hands before handling and consuming food.
- Washing fresh fruits and vegetables before consumption.
- Cooking food to the recommended internal temperature to ensure food safety.
- Avoiding consumption of expired or spoiled food.

## Conclusion
Pregnancy nutrition is critical for ensuring the health and well-being of both mother and baby. By incorporating international pantry staples into a balanced and diverse diet, pregnant women can support a healthy pregnancy. For more information on pregnancy nutrition and recipes, visit our [meal planner](/planner) or [read more about related topics](/blog/topics).

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about pregnancy nutrition, it is essential to consult with a healthcare provider or registered dietitian. They can provide personalized guidance and support to ensure a healthy pregnancy.
